SMPTE Color Bars Test Pattern with Timecode Overlay

A full-screen SMPTE-style color bar test pattern with vertical stripes of red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, and cyan. A diagonal rainbow gradient beam crosses from upper-left to mid-right. A digital timecode display reading 00:00:00.000 appears in the top-left corner, and small cyan squares and a checkered pattern appear over the blue and magenta bars.

Six equal-width vertical color bars fill the frame. The timecode readout sits in a small dark box at the top-left. A thin diagonal rainbow beam spans from the top-left toward the right edge, and decorative cyan squares and a checkerboard cluster overlay the right-center area.
No user interaction is visible; the frame shows a static test pattern at timecode zero
Frame is at timecode 00:00:00.000, indicating the start of the recording
